file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored reservations_list view to use apply_list_filters utility
file_insights.complexity_reduction: Reduced manual filter/pagination logic from 32 lines to 11 lines of core filtering
key_modifications: Extracted status filtering into custom_filter function
Replaced manual search filter implementation with FilterConfig declarative approach
Consolidated pagination logic into apply_list_filters call
Changed context data mapping to use result dictionary structure

patterns_discovered.description: Status filtering logic encapsulated in status_filter function for reuse and clarity
patterns_discovered.example: def status_filter(queryset, value): handles 'active'/'expired' logic with timezone comparison
patterns_discovered.benefit: Separates domain logic from view orchestration

patterns_discovered.description: Filters defined as configuration list rather than imperative code
patterns_discovered.example: FilterConfig with param_name, filter_type, and custom_filter parameters
patterns_discovered.benefit: Makes filter pipeline transparent and easier to modify

patterns_discovered.description: apply_list_filters returns structured dict with 'queryset' and 'filter_values'
patterns_discovered.benefit: Provides consistent interface for accessing filtered data and applied filter values

patterns_discovered.description: Consolidating common view patterns (filtering, pagination, search) into reusable utility
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces boilerplate, improves maintainability across multiple views

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Context variable mapping requires knowledge of result structure
gotchas_discovered.description: When switching from direct variable assignment to result dict, context mapping must match utility's return format
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Documentation and consistent return structure from apply_list_filters

gotchas_discovered.description: Custom filter functions must accept (queryset, value) signature to work with apply_list_filters
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Could be enforced via type hints or documentation

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Default status value must align across template and context
gotchas_discovered.description: Status defaults to 'active' in context but must match what apply_list_filters expects
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Template and utility should reference same constant for default values

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Loss of explicit variable reference in template
gotchas_discovered.description: Template variables like 'search' and 'status' now come from result dict, adding indirection
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Maintain clear mapping between request params and context variables

key_achievements: Successfully refactored reservations_list to use apply_list_filters utility
Maintained all existing filtering functionality (search, status filtering)
Preserved pagination behavior with apply_list_filters integration
Extracted status filtering into reusable custom_filter function
Reduced code duplication through utility adoption
approach_outcome.code_quality_improvement: Replaced imperative filtering/pagination logic with declarative configuration approach
approach_outcome.compatibility: First attempt successful - no iteration required

recommendations.recommendation: Extract status_filter function to a shared utility module if used across multiple views
recommendations.rationale: Promotes consistency and reusability of domain-specific filter logic

recommendations.recommendation: Document apply_list_filters return structure (especially result['filter_values'] and result['queryset']) in utility docstring
recommendations.rationale: Reduces friction when implementing custom filters in other views

recommendations.recommendation: Add integration tests verifying all FilterConfig combinations work correctly with apply_list_filters
recommendations.rationale: Custom filters and search configurations have multiple interaction points

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding constants for default filter values (e.g., DEFAULT_STATUS = 'active') shared between view and template
recommendations.rationale: Prevents hard-coded defaults causing subtle bugs if business logic changes

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding type hints to custom_filter functions and FilterConfig to improve IDE support and catch errors early
recommendations.rationale: Would prevent signature mismatches and make filter pipeline more self-documenting
